purpose: Fixed resource/staging/command registry for the approved W002/B1.1 environment-first r4 verification environment. Names only reviewed resources; no arbitrary shell/argv, remotes, daemon socket, generic Docker/compose proxy or host candidate execution.

stage.mailboxState: new empty run-bound mailbox created for this run only; old mailbox preserved untouched and never consumed
stage.overlayRule: hash-listed source and Linux dependency bytes only; never Windows host node_modules, actual .runtime, credentials, whole checkout or .git

sourceStaging.mode: additive hash-listed bytes via environment-host.mjs stageFiles
sourceStaging.input: reviewed digest map of {rel, sha256} supplied at setup time only; no list is populated before reviewer PASS
sourceStaging.checks: assertStageableRel + resolved-boundary + per-file sha256 verification; exclusive non-symlink project-owned stage root

sourceFilesPlan.provenance: deterministic completeness contract: named root files plus every regular file under apps/, services/, packages/, examples/, tests/, scripts/, infra/, templates/workspaces/, research/fixtures/; excludes node_modules/.runtime/dist/.git, .env* except root .env.example, scripts/tooling/node_modules, this manifest, and credential/key material; lexicographically sorted, duplicate-free

linuxDependencies.provenance: CTO R1 complete Linux installed dependency closure: original tool seeds plus every exact root devDependency/workspace package dependency alias target; canonical root/hash rows independently revalidated on host and Linux before setup. No dependency copies, installs or downloads; existing readonly root mount.

linuxTooling.provenance: recomputed from real bytes by environment-host.mjs verifyDependencyClosure at hostRoot before any Docker call, then bind-mounted read-only at mountTarget; supplies scripts/tooling/node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs to scripts/pnpm.mjs without installs

w002-b11-ws.role: network-namespace anchor and preserved prior workspace
w002-b11-ws.preserve: existing identity, hardening and contents; no stop/recreate or candidate overwrite; bounded harness self-checks allowed only in a separate temporary review directory

w002-b11-svc-private-api.role: fixture private API on shared anchor namespace, localhost inside namespace
w002-b11-svc-private-api.preserve: existing ID, read-only root, non-root user, cap-drop, no-new-privileges and limits; no restart or substitution

w002-b11-svc-external-api.role: fixture external API on shared anchor namespace
w002-b11-svc-external-api.preserve: existing ID, read-only root, non-root user, cap-drop, no-new-privileges and limits; no restart or substitution

w002-b11-db.role: original Box DB, OOM-marked; preserved, not used for new Box-auth runs
w002-b11-db.preserve: contents and identity unchanged; no stop/reset/drop/truncate/recreation

w002-b11-fixture-db-private.role: owned fixture DB for private-api service

w002-b11-fixture-db-external.role: owned fixture DB for external-api service

env.BOX_TEST_DATABASE_URL: synthetic in-memory handoff at create time; postgres://box_fixture:<randomBytes>@w002-b11-box-db-r4-env2:5432/postgres; never logged or persisted

w002-b11-box-db-r4-env2.role: fresh Box-auth PostgreSQL for new run-prefixed fixture databases only

config.tmpfs: required writable dirs tmpfs, owned by image account
config.credentials: synthetic-only new keys generated at creation; never host/real credentials

w002-b11-box-db-r4-env2.preserve: all newly created run-prefixed databases are preserved; capacity/OOM stops rather than drops

preservation.oldMailbox: preserved untouched as evidence; 40 requests/32 responses and 8 unanswered requests never replayed, copied, drained or deleted
preservation.legacyStack: stopped helper, source-image artifact and legacy containers/volumes untouched
preservation.databases: no existing database/dataset reset or bulk cleanup; no DROP/TRUNCATE anywhere

commands.reviewDigestBinding: supervisor recomputes actual bytes for every path in the review record's candidateFiles map at invocation; identical caller-supplied strings alone never release execution

limits.correctionSupervision: progress-based informative corrections and affected reruns within the eight leased paths; no blanket correction/rerun count, no overall active-minute cutoff, no unchanged no-evidence retry loop
